description: The DC office of Congressman Derek Kilmer, hailing from Washington's 6th district, is looking for personable, diligent part-time and full-time unpaid interns to start for the winter session (January) through the spring. The internship allows access to briefings and interesting events related to a wide range of important issues. Responsibilities include assisting with constituent correspondence, producing daily press clips, and leading tours of the Capitol.
